messages.text: For BTC, the short side has 15,907 accounts holding 4,079,258,404 USD, while the long side has 24,199 accounts holding 2,354,421,604 USD, and the short side has unrealised losses of -256,491,123 USD compared to the long side's 48,643,456 USD.
